request.what: Fund UTxO RPC by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Integration Standard, Year 2, including maintenance and enhancement plus Intersect administration.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.
UTxO RPC is an open interface specification for UTxO-based blockchains using Protocol Buffers and SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python.
UTxO RPC has been adopted by Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node as a query interface.
The project maintains more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations under Apache 2.0.
The maintainer scope covers specification maintenance, SDK maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with named reserve and project-specific addresses, multisig-like admin and oversight roles, and dashboard/on-chain auditability.
Independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month UTxO RPC maintenance program administered by Intersect, with claims of ecosystem adoption, open-source infrastructure value, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based oversight.
